name: Cannibalistic Echoes

stealth.details: (master) to sense something unusual lurking in the area's echoes

disable: DC 40 Intimidation check (master) to drive the spirits off with a ferocious display or DC 42 Occultism check (expert) to exorcise the spirits

items.name: Feast
items.text:
Trigger A living creature approaches within 10 feet

---

Effect The spirits bite and chew, dealing 6d12+35 piercing damage to each creature within 30 feet. Affected creatures must each attempt a DC 41 Reflex save save.

---

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage, 2d8 bleed, and is Drained 1.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage, 4d8 bleed, and is Drained 2.

text: A pack of cannibalistic spirits swarm through the area, devouring living creatures.
